title: Trials Season 5: Prove Your Mettle
body:
# **The Rust Belt never settles.**

Menacing machines continue to stalk the surface, and their activity keeps ramping up at a worrying pace. Across Season 4 of your weekly Trials, you've shot, burned, exploded, bludgeoned, and scavenged your way through the chaos, gathering essential supplies and thinning out ARC numbers along the way.

Given all that hard work, a striking new outfit feels like the least you deserve!

Season 4 wraps up on **July 07**, and where you land in the final standings will unlock a range of colors and toggles for the Blindspot Set.

* Tryhard II - Blindspot Outfit Navy Blue color

* Tryhard III - Hat Outfit Variant

* Wildcard I - Padding Outfit Variant

* Wildcard II - Jacket Outfit Variant

* Wildcard III - Mask Outfit Variant

* Hotshot - Blindspot Outfit Green color

* Cantina Legend - Blindspot Outfit Beige Black color

Walk the shoreline of Riven Tides with your life vest strapped on, and stay alert for any beachcombers drifting along the coast!

## **Trials Season 5**

**S5 Start date: 2026-07-07 12:00:00 UTC**

**S5 End date: 2026-09-30 07:00:00 UTC**

Your feedback hasn't gone unnoticed, Raiders — the coming season of Trials arrives packed with a fresh batch of objectives to work through.

Expect everything from dealing damage to specific ARC types with particular weapons (loose lips sink ships), to soaking up Pop explosions right to the face. The upcoming season will push your loadout in new directions, while still bringing back a set of familiar challenges.

## **Trials Season 5 reward outfit - The Scorta**

You know how this works by now. You've got until **September 30th** to work through the new Trials and unlock variations of the Scorta outfit, determined by your final placement!

Top-tier Raiders who climb to Hotshot or Cantina Legend rank will earn exclusive Red and Blue color variants, making sure everyone — Raiders and ARC alike — knows not to try anything.

Gear up like a heavyweight and grab extra cosmetics once the Season closes out:

* Backpack: Green Bruiser

* Backpack Charm: Pressure Gauge

* Backpack attachment: Hydraulic Pump

* Emote: 'Come at me'

ARC activity is climbing, and uneasy partnerships with the Nomads are starting to take shape. Whatever happens next, you'll want heavy armor on your back.

The next Season of Trials is nearly here. Get out there and prove your mettle.
